Maya: Quick follow-up to the gateway RFC-- we saw retry storms when hedging interacts with tenant throttles. Need a compact refactor proposal.
Ben: Repro'd in staging: hedge -> queueing -> throttle -> reject -> client retry loop.
Priya: Particularly bad on embedding-heavy tenants with small quotas.
Javier: Idea: split admission into billing_quota (strict) and hedge_quota (soft). Hedge_quota tracked locally in the edge with tiny leases.
Maya: So proxies hold short leases from central store and spend them without sync RPC per request. Reconcile async.
Ben: Lease batching sizes must be small for hot tenants to avoid oversubscribe. Suggest 1-3 tokens per lease for top N tenants.
Priya: Observability: tag hedges with route/model/tenant/result. Expose hedged_allowed, hedged_denied, hedged_latency metrics.
Maya: Config sketch:
edge_hedging:
  default_window_s: "60"
  routes: ["/v1/chat", "/v1/embeddings"]
  budgets: ["global:1200", "per_tenant:3"]

Javier: Implementation note: local fast path must be lock-free. Use atomic counters per-tenant in the proxy worker. Background reconciler tops up leases.
Ben: When hedge denied, respond header X-Redwood-Hedge: denied; retry-after=150ms to discourage immediate client retries.
Priya: Reconciliation: if admitted hedge later cancelled, reconcile by crediting lease back in central accounting job.
infra-bot: Canary plan created: https://deploys.redwood/internal/plan/1301
Maya: Action items: Priya draft RFC addendum, Javier spike lease cache, Ben add dashboard widgets. Review in Friday arch sync. :thumbsup:
